Dear Sir
In answer to your enquiries I beg to state that I believe my first publication was about the year 1846.[^1] I edited the [Monthly Packet](/periodical/52) from its commencement in 1851 till 1893. I have never resided anywhere but in this village
I remain &c

C M Yonge


[^1]: In fact [Abbeychurch](/book/2) had appeared in 1844.
